ambient: Original good separated strict boundaryless pure n>=2 analytic X over any complete non-Archimedean field, including trivial valuation.
current: Original arbitrary positive middle-cone ordinary CLD (p,p) current, both first differentials closed; p=0,...,n-1.
potentials: Original separately admissible finite continuous psh U,V; no replacement by CPsh, weakly smooth, real PL or a different psh convention.
canonical_curvature: Original delta_X and actual generic Artinian component lengths; no reduction or weight change.
partial_results: Weighted cutoff bound under ordinary smooth zero-Hessian regularity away from an explicitly closed locus.
Removability under explicitly verified vanishing weighted cutoff errors; smooth-trace inverse-oscillation lower bound for every possible nonzero detector.
Arbitrary-current BT on a specified open if the nonsmooth locus is locally closed analytic of dimension <n-p-1 and the smooth Hessian is zero off it.
top_allowed_degree: Dimension bound excludes no nonempty locus when p=n-1; cutoff hypothesis remains unproved universally.
ordinary_open_scope: Specified open or local hypotheses on an ordinary cover there; every-open only when hypotheses are supplied on each such open. No basis is claimed.
unresolved: The full literal every-open/every-current assertion for arbitrary pairs in the original ambient class.
